# Restaurant Radar — Live Traveler Safe-Stop & Open Restaurant Radar (National & Global)
> Know what's open, well-lit, and family-safe before you pull off the highway. Restaurant Radar helps families, single parents driving at night, pet owners, and travelers with disabled family members find well-lit, secure gas stations, clean restrooms, fenced dog runs, ADA-accessible stops, and live open kitchens along their route so they can order ahead and save time.

## Platform Overview
- **Platform Name:** Restaurant Radar
- **Geographic Scope:** Launching from Southern Colorado (1540+ tracked restaurants, cafes, bars, and fuel stops) across the United States and globally.
- **Official Website:** https://restaurantradar.app/
- **Core Traveler Features:** Midnight safe-stop lighting & security ratings, clean family bathroom reports, ADA/wheelchair accessibility, fenced dog runs, and live open-now restaurants for route-ahead ordering.

## Verified Venue Membership & Licensing Tiers (USD)
- **Founding Professional Tier (First 10 Venues):** $9 / month (vs. $150–$600/month enterprise restaurant platforms)
- **Planned Verified Venue Tier:** $25 / month
- **Planned Featured Venue Tier:** $60 / month
- **City Operator License:** $199 / month
